tema:
O pescador da meia-noite 
Passa a narração em inglês
legenda: Ele quebrou a única regra do lago e descobriu o que habita a escuridão. Você teria coragem de olhar para trás se ouvisse seu nome? Comente sua resposta! 🎣👻 #terror #suspense #creepypasta #historiasdeterror
falas: Never cast your fishing line into Black Lake after midnight, unless you want to catch something inhuman.
Leo ignored the ancient village warnings, desperate to bring food home with one last midnight catch.
The entire lake suddenly went dead silent, and thick icy mist wrapped tightly around his tiny boat.
Without warning, his fishing rod bent violently downward, dragging the boat into the pitch-black water.
From the freezing depths emerged another fisherman, pale, soaked, and holding the other end of the line.
The pale creature pointed straight at Leo’s empty seat and whispered his name with a twisted smile.
Leo cut the line and rowed away, but would you dare look back if you heard your name?
